title: Dal
summary: Dal is a lentil stew eaten daily across India. Bengali masoor dal is simple: boiled red lentils with turmeric and salt, finished with a tempering (phoron) of nigella seeds or panch phoron and chillies.
steps: Boil rinsed lentils with turmeric and salt until soft
Heat oil, add phoron and green chillies
Pour the tempering over the dal and simmer briefly
